core.title: The consume-cycle acyclicity check is the exact invariant; separability and granularity signals stay advisory until calibrated
core.given: A wagon-coupling finding is being handled, or wagon-coupling enforcement is being designed, implemented or promoted.
core.when: Deciding how binding a wagon-coupling check is.
core.then: The consume-cycle acyclicity check is the first enforcement and the exact invariant; separability and granularity signals remain advisory and are calibrated on the corpus before any promotion to strict, which remains possible after calibration.
prefer: Conservative graph proxies: cross-wagon fan-in/fan-out, shared-artifact adjacency, strongly connected components (SCCs), community-cut signals.
avoid: Promoting separability or granularity signals to strict without calibrating them first.
Requiring Henry-Kafura (fan_in x fan_out)^2 or treewidth computations as day-one enforcement. They are rationale only.
core.why: Henry-Kafura and treewidth back the super-linear model conceptually. Enforcement uses conservative proxies so that validators do not become noisy before corpus calibration.
evidence: Nonbinding illustration (the source is documentation-only; this is not an acceptance requirement): any separability or granularity check marked strict has been calibrated first.
verification: Documentation-only disposition, severity 2: this principle has no detector of its own and raises no finding of its own; it constrains how the other wagon-coupling checks are bound.
The exact acyclicity invariant (no consume cycle between wagons) is owned and enforced by the consume-cycle rule, not by this rule.
The separability and granularity checks are advisory until calibrated; any strict disposition belongs to those checks after calibration, not to this rule.

Verifier scope: implementations use conservative graph proxies — cross-wagon fan-in/fan-out, shared-artifact adjacency, strongly connected components (SCCs), community-cut signals. Henry-Kafura (fan_in x fan_out)^2 and treewidth are rationale, not day-one enforcement.

fires: Someone handles a coupling, separability, granularity or consume-cycle finding.
Someone treats a separability/granularity signal or a MERGE/SPLIT pattern as a blocking gate before calibration.
Someone designs or implements a wagon-coupling validator, or proposes enforcing Henry-Kafura or treewidth metrics.
Someone proposes promoting an advisory wagon-coupling check to strict.
doesNotFire: Pure footprint scoring with no coupling findings and no validator decisions.

bunOnly.text: planner.wagon.no-consume-cycle is the first enforcement and the exact invariant
bunOnly.reason: The sibling rule's concrete id is a per-corpus realization detail; the core refers to it generically as 'the consume-cycle acyclicity check' so each stack binds its own rule id.

bunOnly.text: The exact acyclicity invariant is owned and enforced by planner.wagon.no-consume-cycle. planner.wagon.separability and planner.wagon.coupling-complexity are advisory until calibrated.
bunOnly.reason: Concrete sibling rule ids are realization details of the ATDD-Bun corpus; the core names the checks generically (consume-cycle rule; separability and granularity checks).

classification.note: Already stack-neutral: names a finding-handling or enforcement-design situation, no stack, path or file kind.
Neutral: deciding how binding a coupling check is.

The obligation (first enforcement = acyclicity invariant; advisory signals; calibrate before promotion; promotion afterwards possible) is neutral and kept in full. Only the sibling rule id is bunOnly.
Neutral: rationale about Henry-Kafura/treewidth as conceptual backing and noise control via proxies.
Graph concepts only; no stack content.
Henry-Kafura and treewidth are general metrics, not stack constructs.
Nonbinding illustration; explicitly not an acceptance requirement. Kept verbatim, it is neutral.
Per-rule disposition (documentation-only) and severity (2) and 'no detector of its own' go to core:verification; the concrete sibling rule ids are bunOnly.
Verifier-scoped restatement of the conservative proxies and of the Henry-Kafura/treewidth exclusion; mapped to the verification array and cross-referenced to the prefer/avoid items it restates.
Finding values are check-output kinds, neutral; observability needs_new_observer retained.
Task terms are metric and posture vocabulary, neutral.
File kinds (validator, validator config, plan, doc) are generic artifact kinds here, not stack suffixes; no profile binding needed.
Phases in which coupling enforcement is decided, built or promoted; llm_judged retained.

neutralityNotes: The rule is a posture rule with no detector, no scanning and no artifact locations, so it needs no profile data; profileRequirements and proposedKeys are empty. 'Wagon' is used as the vocabulary's own concept (a bounded slice of the product, cf. layout.wagon_dir) and names no stack. The only non-neutral fragments are the concrete sibling rule ids (planner.wagon.no-consume-cycle, planner.wagon.separability, planner.wagon.coupling-complexity), which are per-corpus realization details kept in bunOnly; the core names those checks generically so another stack binds its own ids. Per-rule disposition (documentation-only) and severity (2) are kept in core:verification, not in the profile. The fact 'notes' from bun.json are omitted from the core facts (the output schema has no note field); their content is carried by fires/doesNotFire.
